title: ynh quarantine list --format json
description: Output of `ynh quarantine list --format json`. Bare array of entries a failed migration set aside rather than deleting. An empty array is the normal, healthy state. Envelope retrofit deferred, matching the other Phase 3 commands.

name.description: Basename of the quarantined entry, and the key `ynh quarantine restore <name>` and `... drop <name>` take.

path.description: Absolute path inside the quarantine directory.

original_path.description: Where the entry lived before it was set aside. Read from the migration manifest, so it may be absent for an entry quarantined without one.

reason.description: The migration error that caused it. Absent when no manifest recorded one.
